name: Channeling Feats (Legendary Games)
body:
A channeling feat is a feat that has the channel energy ability as a prerequisite and adds to this ability or alters it.

Here are some new ways to declinate your connection to the divine.

Channel Radiance

The pure light of your god fortifies the good and purifies evil.

Prerequisite(s): Channel positive energy 6d6, Sun domain.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, when you channel positive energy, you can expend an additional use to fill the affected area with radiance (as per brightest light) for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level.

Channeling Kinesis

Your kinetic blast can be used as sacred or unholy energy.

Prerequisites(s): Kinetic blast (negative or positive) class feature, metakinesis class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one feat that alters the channel energy ability. Your positive blast counts as channel positive energy and your negative blast as channel negative energy for the purpose of using this feat. You still have to select the chosen feat as normal. Any extended channeling effect selected (like Command Undead) lasts one round only if used this way. Altering a blast with each of these feats costs 1 point of burn.

Special: This feat can be chosen multiple times. Each time, you select a different channeling feat.

Command Alignment

Outsiders of the chosen alignment become your allies and servants.

Prerequisites(s): Channel energy class feature, Alignment Channel.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can use one of your uses of channel energy to force outsiders of the chosen alignment subtype within 30 feet to obey you. You must make this choice each time you channel energy. If you choose to command creatures of the chosen alignment subtype, your channel energy has no effect on other creatures. This functions as Command Undead, but good or lawful outsiders can choose to forfeit their save if the command comes from a legendary cleric of their same alignment or deity. A good cleric using this ability to her own advantage can incur in the displeasure of her god.

Elemental Protection

You grant the protection of your element to creatures healed by your channeled energy.

Prerequisites(s): Channel positive energy 7d6; Air, Earth, Fire, Water, or Weather domain or blessing.

Benefit(s): When you channel positive energy, any creature healed by the channel also gains the effect of healing warmth (using an element matching one domain or blessing you have access to) for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round). This effect has a caster level equal to your effective cleric level.

Elemental Trial

Your deity tests the purity of those who would benefit or be damaged by your channeled energy with an elemental judgment.

Prerequisites(s): Channel energy 7d6; Air, Earth, Fire, Water, or Weather domain or blessing.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can expend one use of your channel energy ability to affect one creature within your channeling range as if you had cast trial by fire (using an element matching one domain or blessing you have access to), at a caster level equal to your effective cleric level.

Turn Alignment

Outsiders of the chosen alignment flee before you.

Prerequisites(s): Channel energy class feature, Alignment Channel.

Benefit(s): You can, as a standard action, use one of your uses of channel energy to cause outsiders of the chosen alignment subtype within 30 feet of you to flee. This functions as Turn Undead. You must make this choice each time you channel energy. If you choose to turn creatures of the chosen alignment subtype, your channel energy has no effect on other creatures. Turning creatures of your same alignment may not be seen with favor from your god.
